---
name: consult-root-docs
description: Consults and summarizes documentation from the root-level docs folder, providing general information about all systems (frontend and backend).
applyTo: ["docs/**/*"]
---

## consult-root-docs

Searches, reads, and summarizes documentation from the root `docs/` directory, offering insights and references that cover the entire ecosystem (frontend and backend), not just local or module-specific documentation.
